international.title: UK pensions department hit by ‘serious cyber incident’, minister says – UK politics live
international.summary: Pat McFadden says the government doesn’t believe any personal data has been compromised Tell us: have you been affected by the DWP ‘cyber incident’ According to Downdetector , which tracks online service outages, reports of problems with the government website appeared to begin last night and peaked at about 8am this morning. Tory MP Neil Shastri-Hurst has also commented on the disruption at the DWP, saying the incident highlights the importance of protecting essential public services and ensuring they can recover quickly when systems fail. Today’s cyber incident at DWP is a stark reminder that national resilience is not a tomorrow issue. It means protecting the essential services people rely on every day, with secure systems and the ability to recover quickly when things go wrong.” Continue reading...
